name: nanovna-tab
description: A NanoVNA tab for Claude Code: live SWR with a plain-language verdict, a trim assistant, an antenna library, QC and band presets, with tools and a coaching skill for Claude.

plugins.name: wildcat-vna
plugins.description: A VNA tab that drives a NanoVNA over USB and teaches what it reads: live SWR at the mesh frequencies with a grade and a verdict, SWR / return loss / R & X / Smith views, a live trim assistant, an antenna library with history and compare, a QC mode with PASS/FAIL and certificates, band presets with their own calibration slots, and a report-card export. /vna to open it. Claude can read the antenna and do the safe button presses with three tools, and the antenna-coach skill teaches SWR and trimming.
